C1407.title: Devin Rhoden and Berman Nowlin NFT Rug Pull and Money Laundering Case
C1407.summary: In February 2024, U.S. federal prosecutors charged Devin Rhoden and Berman Nowlin. Prosecutors alleged that the defendants marketed NFT projects with benefits they did not deliver, abandoned the projects, and transferred the proceeds. They were also accused of moving funds across blockchains and converting them to fiat currency to conceal the source, and faced conspiracy charges for wire fraud and money laundering.
